verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes an Enterprise Service Level Agreement at vercel.com/legal/sla. It commits to 99.99% availability, excluding defined Excused Downtime, and grants a Credit calculated under Section 3 when that level is missed. This covers both the published uptime SLA and the defined downtime credits. Missing for 10: the actual credit tiers or percentages are not shown in the evidence, the SLA covers only Enterprise subscriptions, and there is no independent corroboration of how credits are honored.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can review a published uptime SLA with defined credits for downtime

citations.quote: available 99.99% of the time, excluding any Excused Downtime events, as defined below ('Services Level')
If the Services fail to meet the above Services Level, you will receive a Credit equal to the result of the Services Credit calculation in Section 3 of this SLA.
